evidence_gaps: Fresh sanitised runtime forensics generated within two hours.
Per-attempt immutable timestamps linking signal, quote, simulation, signing, broadcast, receipt/finality and reconciliation.
Money-weighted realised net P&L by chain, strategy version, route, asset, notional and holding period.
EVM actual gas, effective gas price, builder/priority payment, revert cost, nonce/replacement state and wallet-delta reconciliation for every broadcast.
Solana base fee, compute units, priority/Jito fees, platform fees, price impact, rent paid/reclaimed/pending and wallet/token delta reconciliation.
Explicit mutually exclusive STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure classification, including unknown broadcast outcomes.
All candidate and rejected opportunities so selection bias, eligibility rate and no-edge abstention can be measured.
Decision-time executable entry and exit quotes at the actual tested size, including quote age and route identity.
Liquidity depth, sellability, partial-fill behavior and failed-exit observations for both chains.
Predicted-versus-realised slippage and price-impact calibration by chain, venue, asset, size and volatility/congestion regime.
Out-of-sample and forward-window results isolated by exact strategy version and source commit.
Capital exposure duration and inventory mark-to-executable-exit values needed for durable money-weighted returns.
Sufficient independent observations across adverse market, RPC congestion and fee regimes.
Evidence that platform-fee settlement failures and later retries are charged exactly once.

Before promotion: positive failure-adjusted realised net after every irreversible cost, positive lower confidence bound, acceptable drawdown and tail loss, complete landed-transaction reconciliation, bounded unknown outcomes, and no deterioration in a disjoint forward window.

proposals.downside_risk: Additional quote and simulation work may reduce apparent opportunities and can introduce selection bias if unavailable quotes are silently discarded; all attempted observations must therefore be retained with explicit rejection reasons.

evidence.detail: Solana observations set gross edge, fees, slippage, price impact and latency reserve to zero, mark outcome_available false, and declare SIGNAL_ONLY_MISSING_CURRENT_EXECUTABLE_EDGE.

The execution architecture already records base fees, priority fees, Jito tips, platform fees, wallet deltas, and paid/reclaimed rent, but these chain-specific economics are not consumed by the Solana Strategy Lab adapter.
Quote-simulated outcomes are recorded only when the adapter supplies outcome_available and positive notional; current Solana envelopes cannot meet that condition.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces falsifiable, chain-specific Solana SHADOW economics and prevents leader quality or raw signal frequency from masquerading as durable net profitability.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independent market windows and 100 attempted observations per tested notional, spanning multiple congestion and volatility regimes; report all attempts, including zero eligible trades and infrastructure failures.
proposals.rationale: A historical leader success ratio is not an executable edge. Solana needs timestamped entry and exit quotes at the tested size, route price impact, DEX/platform fees, base and priority/Jito fees, latency/adverse-selection reserve, sellability, liquidity, simulation result, and refundable-rent state before a strategy signal can be evaluated. Rent principal should not be treated as permanent loss while recoverable, but failed or unrecovered rent must remain visible.
proposals.shadow_test: For each eligible Solana observation, capture decision-time round-trip executable quotes at fixed tested notionals and compute net outcome after swap/platform fees, price impact, slippage, base fee, priority/Jito fee, latency reserve, execution failures and unrecovered rent. Compare predicted net with a later executable exit quote without broadcasting. Stop and fail the hypothesis if any cost component is missing, sellability or simulation fails, quote age exceeds its limit, failure-adjusted aggregate net is non-positive, or prediction error consumes the edge.
proposals.strategy: Solana Strategy Lab feature and outcome adapter

proposals.downside_risk: Incorrect classification or double-counting could distort results, particularly when a broadcast outcome is initially unknown or Solana rent is later reclaimed.

evidence.detail: Default net profit is gross profit minus gross loss, fees and slippage only; price impact, gas/priority fees, execution-failure cost and capital weighting are not explicit schema components.
Lifecycle decisions use aggregate net profit and profit factor while execution_failures are counted but not separately attributed or economically charged.

EVM success records actual receipt gas and wallet-balance realised net, but exceptions are logged as a generic REJECTED row, potentially combining strategy rejection, pre-broadcast infrastructure failure, uncertain broadcast and reverted execution.
The runtime distinguishes post-execution economic validation failure, showing that landed transactions and infrastructure failures require separate attribution from market losses.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents profitable strategy signals from being discarded for infrastructure faults, prevents failing execution from being hidden behind signal metrics, and makes promotion decisions depend on complete money-weighted net economics.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 attempted observations per chain, with every attempt classified and 100% of landed transactions reconciled; unknown outcomes must be reported separately and block promotion.
proposals.rationale: Strategy/market loss means an economically valid execution or mark-to-executable-exit produced negative net performance. Execution/infrastructure failure means quote, RPC, simulation, signing, broadcast, confirmation, reconciliation or settlement failed. These categories have different remedies, but both can consume money and must enter failure-adjusted net P&L where applicable.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay recorded SHADOW and sanitised runtime events through mutually exclusive classes: STRATEGY_MARKET_LOSS, EXECUTION_PRE_BROADCAST, EXECUTION_REVERT_OR_LANDED_FAILURE, INFRASTRUCTURE_UNKNOWN_OUTCOME, and SUCCESS. Reconcile each landed event to wallet delta and receipts, charge irreversible costs exactly once, and keep recoverable rent pending. Stop if class totals do not reconcile to wallet cash movement or if unknown-outcome events are treated as zero cost.

proposals.downside_risk: Quote-to-inclusion decay, MEV, reverts, stale gas estimates and rare failure costs can eliminate a small simulated spread; historical route success can also overfit.

evidence.detail: Eligibility requires positive net edge after fees, slippage, price impact and latency reserve, plus liquidity, sellability and quote-age gates.
EVM adaptation includes gas and builder payments, slippage reserve, price impact, exact-quote, simulation, liquidity, sellability and whole-route approval requirements.
The wallet path performs a fresh size-specific simulation, waits for a successful receipt and calculates realised net from wrapped-balance change minus actual receipt gas.
Quote/simulation scorecards are explicitly non-promotional and create no live orders.

proposals.expected_effect: Retains a plausible low-inventory-risk hypothesis while measuring failure-adjusted, size-specific realised economics instead of raw win count.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 independent candidates and 50 executable simulations per EVM chain/size segment across 14 days, followed by a disjoint forward window; no CANARY or LIVE promotion from simulation evidence alone.
proposals.rationale: This is the best-supported architectural hypothesis because the cycle is atomic and the current path applies several executable safeguards. Fixed basis-point thresholds still cannot establish edge across EVM chains with materially different gas and inclusion economics, and no fresh realised evidence is available.
proposals.shadow_test: Record every candidate and rejection. At decision-time wallet-specific notionals, compare simulated net with counterfactual or realised receipt-confirmed net after DEX fees, price impact, slippage, builder/priority payments, actual gas, reverts and timeout/unknown-outcome costs. Segment by chain, route, size, congestion and quote age. Stop a segment if failure-adjusted out-of-sample net is non-positive, the lower confidence bound on mean net is not positive, or quote-to-result deterioration exceeds the proposed edge.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy based on the current review.
rejected_ideas.reason: Runtime evidence is absent and the available architecture and simulations cannot prove durable realised net profitability.

rejected_ideas.idea: Optimise for wins, eligible-signal count or participation rate.
rejected_ideas.reason: These counts ignore loss magnitude and execution costs; inactivity is preferable when no positive executable edge exists.

rejected_ideas.idea: Use Solana leader historical positive ratio as a current entry signal.
rejected_ideas.reason: The adapter has no current executable edge, liquidity, sellability, round-trip cost or simulation evidence.

rejected_ideas.idea: Apply one universal minimum-edge threshold across Solana and all EVM chains.
rejected_ideas.reason: Priority fees, gas, inclusion reliability, MEV, rent and price-impact behavior are chain-, route-, size- and regime-specific.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat quote or simulation profitability as realised promotion evidence.
rejected_ideas.reason: It omits adverse execution, failures, reconciliation uncertainty and out-of-sample realised performance.

rejected_ideas.idea: Force trades to obtain a minimum sample.
rejected_ideas.reason: Sampling activity without positive executable edge destroys capital and biases evaluation.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The EVM path has useful fail-closed quote, simulation, liquidity, sellability and receipt-confirmed gas accounting, while the common signal layer requires positive cost-adjusted edge. However, the Solana Strategy Lab adapter deliberately supplies zero current edge and no executable outcome, so Solana strategies cannot yet be economically evaluated there. Strategy Lab accounting also lacks explicit price-impact, gas/priority-fee, rent-state and execution-failure attribution fields, creating a risk that incomplete caller-provided net values or infrastructure failures are interpreted as strategy performance. No profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness claim is supported without fresh runtime forensics and independent realised outcomes.
